description: Find PredictHQ events within a radius of a geographic point (latitude/longitude). Useful for "what is happening near this venue/store/airport" demand-forecasting queries. Filter by category and active-date window; results are ranked by predicted impact. Example: nearby_events({ latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.006, radius: "10km", category: "concerts,sports" }).

_apiKey.description: REQUIRED — your own PredictHQ access token. Pipeworx does not front a key for PredictHQ (14-day trial, then sales contact). Free keyless alternatives for event listings: ticketmaster, seatgeek.

category.description: Comma-separated event categories. One or more of: concerts, sports, conferences, expos, festivals, performing-arts, community, public-holidays, observances, politics, academic, school-holidays, daylight-savings, severe-weather, airport-delays, disasters, terror, health-warnings. Example: "concerts,sports".

end.description: Only include events active on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. "2026-06-30".

latitude.description: Center latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 40.7128.

longitude.description: Center longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. -74.006.

start.description: Only include events active on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. "2026-06-01".

name: nearby_events
title: Nearby Events
